# Wicked Stacks

> Wicked Stacks (wickedstacks.com) is an independent online bookstore by The Insanely Wicked. Every title is written by Michael Gardner and sold with every format included — PDF, EPUB, workbooks, and audiobooks — one price, instant delivery after checkout, future format upgrades free. 30-day money-back guarantee. No subscriptions: buy a book, own the book.

## Books

- [Complete Business Mastery](https://wickedstacks.com/p/complete-business-mastery): The flagship — 17 chapters of practical business building (market sizing, unit economics, sales, hiring, systems) in a plain-spoken, anti-guru voice, plus a full Resource Pack of templates and scripts and four bonus audio deep-dives (~2 hours). $47. Also at cbmbook.com.
- [From Zero to Online Income](https://wickedstacks.com/p/from-zero-to-online-income): A beginner's guide to starting a one-person online business, with a chapter-matched workbook. The honest starting point — no overnight-success promises. $17.
- [Stuck No More](https://wickedstacks.com/p/stuck-no-more): Rebuilding motivation, confidence, and direction — empathetic, practical self-help that meets readers where they are, with the full audiobook edition included. $19.
- [The Digital Tapestry](https://wickedstacks.com/p/the-digital-tapestry): Social media, influence, and taking your attention back — sharp, funny, and complete, with an audiobook edition included. $19.
- [Penny's Piggy Bank](https://wickedstacks.com/p/pennys-piggy-bank): An illustrated kids' story teaching saving and sharing, with a professionally narrated audiobook included. Ages 2–8. $12.
- [Princess Penny's Problem-Solving Party](https://wickedstacks.com/p/princess-pennys-problem-solving-party): A fully illustrated kids' story about breaking big problems into small steps. Ages 2–8. $12.

- [The Tapestry Debates](https://wickedstacks.com/p/tapestry-debates): Two AI-hosted audio debates (~50 minutes) arguing the big questions from The Digital Tapestry — algorithms and attention, connection vs. the trap. $7.
- [Your Shit Stinks Too — The Audio Collection](https://wickedstacks.com/p/your-shit-stinks-too): A growing collection of audio deep-dives on hypocrisy, bias, and shared fallibility, born from a podcast starring Michael Gardner and his dog Frankie. ~2 hours now, new episodes added free and the price rises as the collection grows. $12.

## Bundles (Stacks)

- [The Business Starter Stack](https://wickedstacks.com/p/business-starter-stack): From Zero + Complete Business Mastery with all workbooks and packs. $54.
- [The Clear Head Stack](https://wickedstacks.com/p/clear-head-stack): Stuck No More + The Digital Tapestry, both audiobooks included. $29.
- [Penny's Story Stack](https://wickedstacks.com/p/pennys-story-stack): Both Penny adventures plus the audiobook. $19.
- [The Everything Stack](https://wickedstacks.com/p/everything-stack): The entire library — all books, workbooks, and audio, with future format upgrades free. $79.
